 Right now, a new Faded Wheel Event, La Calabaza has been launched for the server, and the event brings an exclusive emote La Calabaza as a reward to the gaming platform.

 Follow Us
 Free Fire India
 Listen to this article 0.75x 1x 1.5x 00:00 / 00:00 Free Fire India has been launched for the regional server on October 28, 2026. The game marks the return of the original Free Fire game, but with some parental control and restrictions for players below 18 years of age. Also, the new Free Fire India interface will focus on celebrating Indian culture and events, and the first event that will be launched for the server will be Diwali event 2026. The event will run through November 15, 2026, and the players will get an opportunity to win some exclusive free rewards in the event. Right now, a new Faded Wheel Event , La Calabaza has been launched for the server, and the event brings an exclusive emote La Calabaza as a reward to the gaming platform. Faded Wheel events are popular in Free Fire India, as they allow the players to customize their prize pool, and win all the eight selected rewards.

 Advertisment Free Fire India La Calabaza Event- Release Date 
 Free Fire India La Calabaza Event has been launched on October 30, 2026, and will stay on the server for the next 12 days. The event requires spinning with the help of your Free Fire diamonds in order to win some exclusive free rewards like the La Calabaza Emote.
 How to Access the Free Fire India La Calabaza Event? 
 Open Free Fire India on your device.
 Here, go to the luck royale section in the left-hand bar menu.
 Now, go to the La Calabaza event.
 Here you first need to remove two prizes on the screen. These two prizes are the ones that you don’t want from the event.
 After you have made your selection, you can click on ‘Confirm’.
 Now, you can make spins using Free Fire diamonds to win rewards in the event. You will need 9 diamonds to make your first spin, and the diamonds required for spin will increase with every draw.
 Prizes already obtained will not be repeated in the event.

 Advertisment How to Get All the Eight Selected Rewards in Free Fire India La Calabaza Faded Wheel Event? 
 In a Faded Wheel event, you first remove two lesser items from a 10-item prize pool. Then, you spend diamonds sequentially for spins. The cost increases with each spin—typically starting at 9 diamonds and scaling up to 499 for the final spin—guaranteeing you get all eight remaining rewards. Each spin guarantees a unique item, meaning you will never receive a duplicate reward. Because the grand prize often drops near the end, you should expect to spend roughly 1,000 to 1,200 diamonds to clear the wheel entirely. 
 This is How You Need to Spin in a Free Fire India Faded Wheel Event to Get All the Rewards:

 Free Fire India La Calabaza Event will stay for a limited time on the server. The players can spin and win all the selected rewards in the event.
